FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
WHERE fiscal_period = 4
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(*) as count_2025, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as distinct_stores_2025 FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2025

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(r.net_sales) as total_net_sales,
  SUM(r.receipts) as total_receipts,
  SUM(r.units_sold) as total_units
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 lfl ON r.store_id = lfl.store_id
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year

-- Check if the store lists are the same
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_in_both,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l24.store_id IS NOT NULL AND l25.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN l24.store_id END) as in_both_lists
FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 l24
FULL OUTER JOIN tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 l25 ON l24.store_id = l25.store_id

-- Like-for-like sales per store for period 4
SELECT 
  r.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  CASE WHEN fy25.net_sales IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE fy25.net_sales END as fy25_net_sales,
  CASE WHEN fy24.net_sales IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE fy24.net_sales END as fy24_net_sales,
  CASE WHEN fy24.net_sales = 0 THEN NULL 
       ELSE ROUND((CASE WHEN fy25.net_sales IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE fy25.net_sales END - CASE WHEN fy24.net_sales IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE fy24.net_sales END) / CASE WHEN fy24.net_sales IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE fy24.net_sales END * 100, 1)
  END as growth_pct
FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 lfl
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON lfl.store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  GROUP BY r.store_id
) fy25 ON lfl.store_id = fy25.store_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  GROUP BY r.store_id
) fy24 ON lfl.store_id = fy24.store_id
ORDER BY r.store_id

-- Like-for-like sales per store for period 4
SELECT 
  lfl.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0) as fy25_net_sales,
  COALESCE(fy24.net_sales, 0) as fy24_net_sales,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(fy24.net_sales, 0) = 0 THEN NULL 
       ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0) - COALESCE(fy24.net_sales, 0)) / COALESCE(fy24.net_sales, 1) * 100, 1)
  END as growth_pct
FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 lfl
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON lfl.store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  GROUP BY r.store_id
) fy25 ON lfl.store_id = fy25.store_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  GROUP BY r.store_id
) fy24 ON lfl.store_id = fy24.store_id
ORDER BY lfl.store_id

-- Overall like-for-like summary
SELECT 
  SUM(fy25.net_sales) as fy25_total_net_sales,
  SUM(fy24.net_sales) as fy24_total_net_sales,
  ROUND((SUM(fy25.net_sales) - SUM(fy24.net_sales)) / SUM(fy24.net_sales) * 100, 1) as overall_growth_pct,
  COUNT(*) as store_count
FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 lfl
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  GROUP BY r.store_id
) fy25 ON lfl.store_id = fy25.store_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  GROUP BY r.store_id
) fy24 ON lfl.store_id = fy24.store_id

-- Check for data availability
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN fy25.net_sales IS NULL THEN 'Missing FY25' 
       WHEN fy24.net_sales IS NULL THEN 'Missing FY24'
       ELSE 'Complete' END as data_status,
  COUNT(*) as store_count
FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 lfl
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  GROUP BY r.store_id
) fy25 ON lfl.store_id = fy25.store_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  GROUP BY r.store_id
) fy24 ON lfl.store_id = fy24.store_id
GROUP BY data_status
